column1: # Decisions on upstream commits that are not in this branch. One line per commit:
# commit<TAB>decision<TAB>date<TAB>why. decision: skip (never), later (look again when it reaches
# upstream main or we need it). Taken commits need no line: cherry-pick -x records them.
# nevpn/upstream-review.sh lists every upstream commit that is in neither.

column4: KDF context pinned to a placeholder. We pass an explicit context (nevpn://<node>/slot/<id>) on both ends, so it changes nothing for us; it needs nightly-only kdfcontext changes and breaks peers that derive the context. Take when it reaches team main.
Upstream mobile UI: carrier links and a pinned carrier. Our apps use packages/openflux-carrier, not upstream's mobile package, and pin nothing.
captcha -> prompt rename for services with a sign-in; we run none of them.
Script (JS) transports over WebRTC; we build no script transport.
Node kit for upstream's node installer; no upstream installer runs on our nodes.
pion/sctp replace for upstream's mobile module.
Upstream mobile package: CarrierMTU for its TUN.
